articleTitle: The Impact of Carbon Regulation Instruments on the Scale of Technology Development in the Russian Energy Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The optimization of the structure of the Russian power sector for various carbon regulation instruments was conducted. The analysis of the impact of carbon policies on the change in installed capacity and electricity production of various types of power plants (PPs) in the Russian power system by 2050, as well as the cumulative reduction of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, was carried out. The most significant impact on technology development is the direct GHG emissions limitation and the implementation of tax on carbon or GHG emissions. It is shown that the total increase in installed capacity of PPs by 2050 relative to the reporting year may differ by almost seven times for different carbon regulation instruments.

articleTitle: Improved Detection of Related Objects on the Example of Human Re-Identification Task
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology for improved detection of related objects, such as silhouettes and their attributes, using a new loss function in the YOLOv8 model. The human re-identification task is used as an example to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of recognition.

articleTitle: Improving the Credit Risk Assessment Model Using Forecasting and Monte Carlo Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: To improve the assessment model of credit risk by Merton for Russian financial market using the Monte Carlo simulation method and the SARIMA model for data forecasting. Nowadays, there are many methods of the assessment use in European countries. However, the applications of these methods may lead to inaccurate forecasts. In this work, modern methods of credit risk assessment by Merton and Vasicek were adapted and improved. These methods are proposed to be used in the implementation of the Monte Carlo simulation model, which has a high adaptive capacity, which allows it to be effectively used in Russian conditions. The proposed model for assessing credit risks was tested on actual data from companies in two industries. The results showed its effectiveness and the possibility of application in the Russian credit market.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of a Model of Optimal Production Expansion with External Financing
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This work is aimed at studying the optimal behavior of a producer who decides to redistribute part of the proceeds to expand production. At the initial point in time, the firm receives from the investor a certain amount that must be returned over a set period of time. The problem is formulated as an optimal control problem with an inequality type constraint. The work presents a possible numerical implementation of such a problem and studies the influence of the model parameters on the optimal behaviour of the producer.

articleTitle: Monitoring the Dimensions of Elongated Object Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This research endeavors to establish a methodology for forecasting the sizes of anomalies exceeding normative thresholds in elongated structures such as roads, railway tracks, pipelines, and bridges. While substantial advancements have been achieved in prognosticating the maintenance needs of elongated objects, the effective application of time series prediction techniques for estimating the dimensions of defects remains constrained. The proposed approach entails a statistical examination of a multidimensional feature space, formulation of input, output, and control parameters, construction of a two-dimensional grid, and projection of defect dimensions within the grid framework. The final phase integrates a linear regression model with Ll regularization, demonstrating practicality in predicting defect sizes while mitigating overfitting and enhancing model generalization through complexity penalization. The resultant model offers early detection capabilities for potential issues and facilitates timely preemptive maintenance actions by forecasting defect dimensions based on an extensive array of features.

articleTitle: Forecasting an Increase in the Availability of Air Transportation in the Transport System of the Russian Federation for the Long Term
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: An approach to assessing the accessibility of aviation transport to citizens of the Russian Federation is proposed, taking into account modern market conditions for various income groups of the population. A mathematical model has been developed to assess the importance of several factors that determine the attractiveness of air transport. We have formed the requirements for the considered scenarios to the cost of air transportation, in which the target level of aviation mobility is achieved.

articleTitle: Modelling of Carbon Dioxide Emission Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper aims to construct a model and algorithms that apply econometric and neural analysis to identify major factors influencing carbon dioxide emissions. We use the database Enerdata which collects global data on the energy industry, from which data on the nuclear power of different countries are extracted. The computational results obtained in the linear analysis and neural analysis of such parameters as crude oil production showed a degree of influence of 1.16% (in the linear analysis) and 24.13% (in the neural analysis).

articleTitle: Using the Virial Equation of State to Approximate Methane Data
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This study explores the virial equation of state as a model for approximating thermodynamic data for methane. We review the historical development of thermodynamic geometry, highlighting foundational contributions by Lychagin, who applied geometric methods to derive physical insights into energy con-servation, thermodynamic stability, and phase transitions. Using data from the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and prior studies, we modeled the second and third virial coefficients with polynomial expressions to achieve a high degree of accuracy in describing the thermodynamic behavior of methane across a range of temperatures and pressures.

articleTitle: Eliminate Structural Flaws in Aircraft Design
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Modern methods of aircraft design and certification ensure high reliability of design solutions, but design errors that occur during the design process may require redesign of some elements. This paper assesses the feasibility of a redesign cost study and considers some typical scenarios where redesign may occur.

articleTitle: Critical Regime of Combustion Process Taking into Account the Consumption of the Oxidizer
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This work is devoted to the solution to the problem of critical conditions for the autocatalytic model of combustion taking into account the consumption of reactant and oxidizer. The analysis of the mathematical model of this process by methods of geometric singular perturbation theory has shown that there are two main types of combustion modes: the slow combustion mode and the explosive mode. The critical regime is intermediate between them. In the paper, the condition for the critical regime is obtained in the form of an asymptotic expansion of the corresponding value of the system parameter characterising heat transfer from the reaction phase.

articleTitle: A Distributed Method of Computationally Hard Optimization Based on Edge Devices Usage
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Nowadays a wide range of complex optimization problems are solved in a distributed way by edge devices. This paper presents a new method of optimization, based on metaheuristics independent runs, objective function calls blocks forming and assignment and efficient metaheuristic selection for the blocks forming and assignment. Compared with fixed volumes of objective function calls blocks processing, the positive effect on time costs and optimization problem results has been achieved. The method proposed decreases the time cost up to 10 times with the similar problem solving results, and increases the resulting values of criteria significantly with the time cost increase up to 4 times in comparison with the minimum objective functions calls block size.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Early Proactive Control of the Orbital Motion of a Charged Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The orbital motion of a charged spacecraft in the geomagnetic field is investigated. In order to block the disturbing effect of the Lorentz force on the parameters of the spacecraft's orbit, the mathematical apparatus for early proactive control is built. The proposed PID controller protects the spacecraft's orbit from reversal and shape distortion.

articleTitle: A Natural Fortress Defense Condition as a Necessary Circumstance of an Agricultural Society Born (as a Branch of the Classical Oasis Theory)
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Starting from the prof. Emelyanov's paradoxes, here we present a specific theory of young agricultural societies boning. We insist that the agrarian society may appear with enough probability only in a substantially specific region, where alternative nomadic societies and cultures cannot destroy it or at least its innovations for a two-digit number of human generations. That means we should expect such occasions in poorly populated (desert) and poorly transportable landscapes and we put forward a three-stage theory. For reasons of susceptibility to external raids by armies and small enough groups of the “Asian type” using the rush-retreat tactics, the primary focus of agriculture can be formed only in the zone of maximum rest, that is, isolation (a typical “two-layer contour” - (arid) mountainous terrain - desert or semi-desert). As productivity increases, the requirements for the degree of spatial isolation of the agricultural area gradually decrease and secondary foci of agriculture with a weaker level of isolation may arise: a hollow bounded in a mountain range near the sea or a large flat river in a radically arid desert. Only at the last stage - mainly with the invention of normal firearms - agriculture can penetrate arbitrary open and forested areas that are most convenient for this.

articleTitle: New Approaches to Assessing the Development of Cluster Infrastructure of the Republic of Belarus
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article aims to introduce an authorial approach to enhance the methodology of evaluating the economic cluster infrastructure development, exemplified by the Republic of Belarus. It suggests a set of indicators that describe the socio-technological infrastructure of the country's clustering from 2012 to 2021 and computes the aggregate average growth rate of these indicators. The paper outlines the principal institutional design measures implemented in Belarus to foster the development of cluster infrastructure. It also constructs graphic models of paired regression between the Global Connectivity Index of Belarus and the most institutionally correlated indicators of cluster infrastructure development. Furthermore, a multiple regression model has been developed, considering the Global Connectivity Index's dependency on the number of science and technology park residents and the job creation within these parks. The article concludes with recommendations for advancing cluster development in Belarus.

articleTitle: Econometric Model of the Indicator for Identifying Crisis Situations
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to constructing a statistical model for predicting crises associated with adverse economic events. The relevance of the research is determined by the crises accompanying the economic development of modern society. An economic crisis is characterized by a noticeable decline in the production and stock indexes and a significant reduction in business activity.

articleTitle: Planning the Operations of a Group of Autonomous Unmanned Underwater Vehicles Based on a Carrier Vessel as a Solution for Multiple Traveling Salesmen Problem With Some Restrictions
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We regard monitoring of a river or water basin. We propose a method for calculating the work carried out as part of this activity. A group of autonomous unmanned underwater vehicles (AUVs), accompanied by a carrier vessel, do the job based on a two-level model. Examples of monitoring are given for arbitrarily located inspection points using the mathematical apparatus of multiple traveling salesmen problem with some restrictions.

articleTitle: On Some Issues of Modeling a Pressure Compensator in a Flexible Modeling System
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses aspects of modeling a pressure compensator based on two models (equilibrium and a model that considers the nonequilibrium of the vapor and water phases), which are part of a flexible modeling system (FMS). The limits of applicability of the presented models are considered. The results of verification of the presented model of a pressure compensator as part of the FMS in the dynamic mode of a power unit nuclear power plant were carried out.

articleTitle: Rapid Monitoring of Translation Style Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The method of rapid monitoring of linguistic analysis of translated written texts is presented as part of the development of a large-scale information and analytical system. This method is based on the comparison of idiostylistic indicators, using service words as identification markers. These markers characterize the unique features of translated texts, and their weight coefficients are calculated to compare the volume of words in translations produced by “manual” and machine methods.

articleTitle: Correct and Coordinated Planning and Incentive Mechanisms in Systems with Two Agents
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with the control problems of an active system consisting of two agents and a Centre. The existence of loss functions determines the links between the agents in the agents' objective functions depending on the degree of consistency of their strategies. The equilibrium conditions for different options of links between agents and the optimality of the equilibrium state of the system are studied.

articleTitle: Production Distribution by Multiple Auction Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We describe a model of company interaction inside an association. The association creates products from the parts provided by its companies. We propose a solution based on network principles using multiple auction scheme, by which the production is distributed between companies.

articleTitle: The Diagnostics Methods of Software and Hardware for Data Exchange in APCS of NPP
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The diagnostics of exchange of data between the elements of the top and base level systems of the Automated process control system (APCS) of a Nuclear power plant (NPP) is considering. The methods and the algorithms of diagnostics of the software and the hardware of the APCS of the NPP of the exchange of data are proposing.

Author Keywords: subsystems of top and base levels of APCS of NPP

articleTitle: On the Influence of Bots and Content Moderation on User Opinions in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper examines a simulation model of information cascade formation (a sequence of comments) on a social network post. It assumes that a user has two parameters characterizing their opinion and action. User opinions are influenced by previously written comments (including those by bots) that the user sees. Additionally, some comments may be removed during moderation.

articleTitle: Approaches to the Selection of Predictive Models Based on Associative Search for Assessing the Risk Potential of the Technological Process at the NPP Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This article aims to systematize approaches to selecting predictive models based on associative search and analyze their effectiveness and applicability in the operating conditions of nuclear power plants (NPP). The study examines the main approaches and algorithms used for associative data analysis. In addition, the article includes a review of existing work in this area, evaluates its results, and suggests new promising directions for further research. The article is devoted to the issue of selecting a predictive model based on associative search for a technological process (TP) parameter to predict the risk potential of the TP of an NPP power unit using the example of one of the parameters of the information task of the upper level control system of the automated process control system of an NPP - cooling water heating.

articleTitle: Equilibrium in Market Models Described by Systems of Differential and Algebraic Equations
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The market equilibrium reflects the most favorable situation in the economy. The search for conditions for the existence of an equilibrium position is one of the main applied tasks in modern mathematical economics. This paper presents the results of solving a specific problem of researching a mathematical model of the market. The conditions for the existence of an equilibrium position in the model are obtained.

articleTitle: Enterprise Sustainability During a Crisis Using Linguistic Assessments
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The report examines a model of the functioning of a business organization in times of crisis. The model considers multi-valued cognitive maps as the main instrument. The notion of the multi-valued cognitive map generalizes a similar fuzzy concept to the case of linguistic meanings of weights and concepts without converting them into numerical values. An evolution program has been improved for this map, and the evolution of the map has been studied with some new linguistic rating scale.

articleTitle: The Neural Networks Information Security Risk in Multiple Variety Attacks Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors propose the methodology based on the combined use of fuzzy logic and regression analysis methods that allows us to assess the information security risk level of neural networks depending on the threat levels during the implementation of many different attacks.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Selection of a Public-Private Partnership Model in Investment Activity Based on Multifactor Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article's relevance is due to the growing importance of public-private partnerships (PPP) as a mechanism that facilitates the compelling attraction of private investment in the development of infrastructure and social projects. In modern conditions, when countries face budgetary resource constraints and the need to implement large investment programs, choosing the optimal PPP model is becoming a critical factor in achieving sustainable economic growth. Multifactor optimization allows taking into account various criteria when choosing a PPP model, such as financial efficiency, risks, social impact and environmental aspects. This provides a more balanced and comprehensive approach to decision-making, which is especially important in the context of geopolitical uncertainty and rapidly changing economic realities. The development of an algorithm that takes into account many factors helps to increase the transparency and efficiency of the PPP model selection process, which, in turn, can help create a more attractive investment environment and improve public services.

articleTitle: Methods for Analyzing School Shooter's Written Communication to Predict Warning Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the initial results of automated meaningful features identification contained in written communication of known school shooters. An analysis of open data sets was performed to identify characteristic cognitive, emotional, psychological, and behavioral traits. The identified features will allow for the creation of a methodology for identifying violent behavior warning signals in potential school shooters.

articleTitle: Optimization of Heterogeneous Cargo Transportation Plan in Unmanned Air Transportation System by the Criterion of Minimum Time
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problem of constructing a plan for heterogeneous cargo by unmanned aerial vehicles, to minimize transportation time while adhering to the constraints imposed by the capacity of the route network, is addressed. An optimization model is constructed, and a methodology for finding the optimal plan is proposed.

articleTitle: Design of Optimal Well Placement Schemes in Oil and Gas Fields Based on the Synthesis of Linear Programming and Random Search Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This study proposes algorithms for optimal well placement in oil and gas fields. These algorithms allow the initial discrete programming problem of large dimensionality to be replaced by a series of linear programming problems of transportation type. In order to reduce the number of solved problems, it is proposed that random search algorithms be used.

articleTitle: Hierarchal Compromise
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Decision making problems in two-level organization player interaction model are considered. Global and Russian experience in interstate economical and ecological interactions and balance relations system formation are described. Basic methodic foundation for the research, recommendations development, regulation department strategy based on Pareto principle, are formulated.

articleTitle: Non-Standard Way of Applying Watermark for Sound Stream with Sound Stream Structuring
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper a formal formulation of the problem of applying non-stationary watermark to audio files, the technology of its application and extraction and research proving the stability of the watermark, the impossibility of predefining the location of potential points and the portability of the watermark when converting to other sound file formats with lossless recordings are represented. The essence of the algorithm for selecting potential points is omitted in this article.

Author Keywords: scheme of applying and extracting watermark for audio file

articleTitle: Construction of a Nonlinear Model of an Enterprise Based on its Structure and Business Processes Description
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Based on the presentation of the enterprise as a hierarchy of structural units and a set of business processes, a development of a formalized system of state equations was shown. The system allows analyzing the dynamics of the enterprise using methods of control theory. The synthesized model is used to forecast and support management decision-making at the company management level.

articleTitle: The Potential for Enhancement Methods of Data Mining for Monitoring Regional Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper presents conceptual approach to the development of a methodology for automating the monitoring of regional economy's development characteristics based on the application of decomposition methods for deterministic indicators. Based on this approach, model software has been implemented to assess the structural components of gross value added and to build parameters for sectoral development further.

articleTitle: Conceptualization of the Orchestration as a Form of Ecosystem Business Model Control and Development the Model of a Load Dispatching in Them
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The author conceptualized the orchestration form of control over such large-scale systems as ecosystem business models, revealed its content, developed a conceptual model of load dispatching in ecosystem business model and proposed its mathematical justification.

articleTitle: The Phenomenon of the Near-Crisis Interest Rates Blow Up in the Context of Constant Inelastic Demand for Refinancing Short Credits
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Using the critical model of volatile equilibrium, which solves the problem of introducing macroeconomic variables - finance and money - into the standard, model of general equilibrium, it was previously shown that under certain conditions, all enterprises periodically find themselves exactly on the edge of bankruptcy (or overcome it). At the same time, for the sake of brevity, we considered that loans are issued by a bank with an absolutely elastic supply (for example, the state Treasury), so, we did not take into account the ability to issue loans that are limited in terms of reservation requirements and, most importantly, variable over time, taking into account variations in asset quality in different phases of the business cycle: in the low phase of the business cycle, the management of enterprises is ready to take loans at almost any interest rate, and banks are extremely limited in the legally permitted volume of lending, which, without proper regulation, must generate and practically generates a blow up of interest rates.

articleTitle: Multi-Industry Model of Synthesis of Reproduction and Final Consumption Control
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A model of synthesis of control of the system of reproduction is considered. Models of management of the economic system of reproduction use various effects of external influences, expressed in changes in the structure of its technological core. When some surplus of production resources is available, purposeful changes in output are reversible and can occur in one cycle of reproduction. When the reserve of production resources is exhausted, the increase in production assets takes place over several cycles of reproduction. This process has different characteristics from a reversible process. Changes in the structure of final consumption also cause irreversible changes in the process of reproduction. We should have in mind these features in our model for management of the restructuring of the technological basis. The goals of management are to succeed in productivity and sustainability of the reproduction system. The specificity of these models lies in the fact that the response of the system depends on the output volumes of industries, the increase of final consumption, and the surplus of production resources. With a purposeful change of control parameters within the framework of the model of an integrated development fund, the productivity of the system can reach the maximum value (the productivity potential). Changes in the structure of final consumption accompany the changes in production capacities of the system. Influences of this type lead to irreversible changes in the structure of the reproductive system. In addition, starting with a certain amount of consumption, its productivity potential begins to increase. Our purpose in this article is to investigate the methods of synthesis of structural control of the reproductive system's technological basis under reversible and irreversible transformations of the reproduction system.

articleTitle: Principles of Scaling Cloud Computing of Digital Twins Using Accelerator Computers with Mass Multi-Core Parallelism
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In relation to large industrially significant systems (using the example of nuclear power plants (NPP)), the ways of developing the architecture and functionality of cloud systems are considered. The development ways are aimed at providing full-featured cloud services based on industry standards for a system-holistic solution to the entire range of problems of using digital twin technologies with high computational complexity. The possibilities of increasing computing performance through the hybrid amplification of cloud servers by interfacing them with accelerator computers with mass, dynamically scalable multi-core parallelism (hundreds, thousands and more computing cores) are shown. The method of dynamic scaling of mass multi-core parallelism is proposed, intended to expand the space of virtualization of cloud resources.

Author Keywords: accelerator computers with mass multi-core parallelism
method for dynamical scaling mass multicore parallelism

articleTitle: Determining Production System Parameters when Performing a Complex of Jobs with Directive Deadlines
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: . A multi-level regional project management system is considered, in which targets and policy indicators for implementing a set of works implemented at the lower management level (production) are set at the upper level (Center). The problem is formulated of determining the parameters of the production system (performance of executive mechanisms, volumes of resources and efficiency of their use). This allows us to complete a given set of works within a pre-set time frame. We use network modeling and algorithms for finding flows with specified properties in networks with winnings to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Game with Cooperative Behavior of Lower Level Players
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A model of a two-level hierarchical system with many participants is studied assuming that lower-level elements choose Pareto optimal outcomes. Two classes of games are studied: without feedback and with feedback. The maximal guaranteed results are found.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization in the Tasks of Organizing Labor Resources in the Context of Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The development of a methodology for modeling the technological preparation of flexible production processes considering the probabilities of successful execution of technological operations underscores the relevance of creating a unified formalized approach to workforce organization. It involves the development of methods and algorithms for modeling labor processes in conjunction with sociological models.

articleTitle: Effect of Final Consumption Parameters on the Productivity of the Reproduction System
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The balance model of reproduction is aimed at solving the problem of material provision of programs or other needs of the state. It allows to estimate necessary changes of output, gross product, the maximum possible volume of final consumption of different sectors of the economy, as well as estimation of actual and equal productivity. The method used for controlling a reproduction system consists in changing the cost structure and the final consumption volume. This method allows for a certain reserve of productive resources. In the event of a shortfall in the reserve of production resources, the process of forming additional production facilities is initiated in parallel with reproduction. The fund-raising process can be stimulated by an increase in the share of final consumption in output, which in turn can be achieved by stimulating the corresponding demand. Balanced funding helps to maintain final consumption. On the other hand, starting with a certain level of final consumption, equilibrium mode productivity starts to exceed its actual level, which means the point of bifurcation, When the increase in final consumption for equilibrium reproduction mode ensures a steady increase in productivity.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Model of Protest Campaign with Dynamic Network
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Agent-based models on networks most often assume static networks. However, in some contexts political science provides arguments that the dynamical character of the network should be taken into account. Specifically, during a protest campaign, new social ties between the participants may occur. Here we present an agent-based model of protest campaign and some numerical experiments with it. It is shown that under some parameters, the role of new social ties may be significant.

articleTitle: Econometric Modeling of Corporate Profits in the United States of America
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The main aim of the presented article is to develop an econometric model to forecast the financial performance of US companies. To achieve the stated goal, the Gretl software product was used in this research. Gretl is designed to obtain estimates of the model coefficients using various statistical methods. We used the ordinary least squares method. As a result of the research, the value of corporate profits and liability levels were found to be dependent on GDP, wages, industrial output, and consumption expenditures. Identifying the dependence the corporate profit allowed us to make conclusions, namely: the growth of US GDP and consumption leads to an increase in the profit of American corporations, while an increase in industrial production, on the contrary, leads to a decrease in profit. This also allowed us to predict changes in corporate profit depending on changes in macroeconomic indicators.

articleTitle: Information System Based on Relational and Graph Databases
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The issue of creating information systems using relational and graph databases is being considered. The methodology of graphical construction of data schemas of various types is briefly defined, indicating the software tools used for this purpose. The methods necessary to create databases based on the developed schemes are specified.

articleTitle: Approaches to Modelling of the Tension-Strain State of a Hinge Joint
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The accuracy of modelling the stress-strain state of a structure, the analysis of its behaviour under the action of external loads and the assessment of the structural strength of the product are currently the most important issues in the development of science and technology. This paper considers approaches to modelling a weak link as an element of a complex hinge joint design and makes a comparative assessment of the accuracy of the techniques considered.

articleTitle: Metasystems in the Strategic Management of the Region
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Instead of the traditional “system-environment” pair for objects of the regional economy, it is proposed to consider metasystems - these objects together with all interacting objects of the microenvironment. Each object is considered as a point in the multidimensional space of characteristics. Objects are visualized to reflect their development and interaction with other objects.

articleTitle: Control of Information Synthesis for the Ergatic System Simulator
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The task was to assess the psychophysiological capabilities of potential operators in recognizing these signals. It is shown that the greatest significance from the The task was to assess the psycho physiological capabilities of potential operators in recognizing these signals. It is shown that the greatest significance from the point of view of the psychological type of the subjects is personal and situational anxiety, whichnegatively affects the ability the psychological type of the subjects is personal and situational anxiety, which negatively affects the ability to recognize natural and artificial signals.

Author Keywords: psychological profile of the operator Introduction

articleTitle: Neural Network Models of Earth Geophysical Fields for a Physical Polygon
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper deals with the possibility of constructing models neural network spatial and surface of the Earth fields for navigation of uncrewed vehicles. The authors present the possibility of constructing a neural network model of a multigeophysical field based on their combination. An example illustrates the neural network model realization for a relief field.

articleTitle: The Indicative Plan Models: Industries and Companies
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers a multi-level model of indicative planning of target indicators in the system: “Country - Industries - Enterprises - Products.” The problem of analysis and forecasting of the country's target indicators is considered using the example of the “GDP by PPP” indicator. The “GDP by PPP” indicator is linked to industry and organization data. The task is to link GDP with the output of products (orders). Estimates are made of the necessary growth of GDP and gross added value (GVA) of individual industries for the implementation of the target scenario. The initial data are data from Rosstat, the Federal Tax Service of Russia, at the lower level-information from BI and ERP systems of enterprises.

articleTitle: Contact Structures in Continuous Media Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper is devoted to two applications of contact geometry to problems arising in the theory of continuous media control: control of the thermodynamic state of a van der Waals gas and control of liquid crystals. The first problem is reduced to constructing vector fields on a two-dimensional Lagrangian manifold, which is determined by the equations of the thermodynamic states of the gas. The second one is devoted to the method of solving the Cauchy problem for the Hunter-Saxton equation, which describes the dynamics of liquid-crystal structures.

articleTitle: Economic Policy: ‘Cumulative Effect’ and ‘Distributed Management’
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article examines the problems of economic policy formation in the light of new ideas about the ‘cumulative effect’ and ‘distributed management’, which change the content of the economic policy standard theory. The purpose of the research is to show, at the theoretical level of analysis, the existence of a cumulative effect and the possibility of ‘distributed management’ to increase the effectiveness of economic development policy. The research methodology is presented by the theory of economic policy, the author's doctrine of ‘distributed management’, and the ‘cumulative effect’ of politics. The main result is that the theory of economic policy should proceed from the need to coordinate the structure of goals, policy tools, factors, and the economic structure, according to which the tools revealing different powers of influence are distributed in different ways. This theoretical approach requires a different mathematical notation of J. Tinbergen's principle, which can be achieved by writing down equations linking goals, for example, growth and inflation, with factors. By defining the factors, it is possible to construct equations describing the tools' influence on them and linking factors with the dynamics of the economic structure. For example, the input-output method, which connects the vector of final demand and the vector of policy tools, as well as the vector of production costs, may include equations linking demand structures with tools and separate costs and output with other tools, equations of the relationship of tools with each other and accounting for collinearity of goals may be needed.

articleTitle: Model for Optimizing the Spatial Development of Production and Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems of spatial development optimization of production and transport systems (PTS) are considered. They include production elements (enterprises), transport infrastructure connecting production elements with consumption nodes (markets). It is assumed that for the initial period the production capacities of enterprises, the dynamics of demand for products in consumption nodes and the capacity of the transport infrastructure are specified. In addition, possible investment options for the development of production and transport elements of the system are specified. In this case, the problem is reduced to choosing an investment program option aimed at developing production and transport elements of the system that ensures satisfaction of demand with minimal costs. An optimization problem with continuous and integer variables is formulated. Examples of using this approach to solve several practical problems are given.

articleTitle: The Application of Ensemble Machine Learning Methods for Construction of Surrogate Models in Problems of Preliminary Design of an Aircraft Wing Airfoil
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper investigates techniques for creating surrogate models utilizing ensemble machine learning approaches. The utilization of surrogate models considerably reduces the amount of time required for searching for optimal geometrical characteristics of an aircraft's wing. The issue of determining rational aerodynamic features for the wing configuration of an aircraft is addressed in this paper.

articleTitle: Self-Studying Classification of Costs of Transport Complex
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A two-level cost management system for the transport complex is considered. On the upper level of this system is the Center, and on the lower level is the visionary executor. A theorem has been proven about the Center's optimal classification of the executor's costs into two classes using a norm configured using the Center's digital self-studying procedure. When the conditions of the theorem are met, the executor's costs are minimized, and the best estimate of the optimal parameter that minimizes the risk of an inexperienced Center is determined. Also, the theorem has been proven about the Center's optimal classification of the executor's costs into four classes using a standard and two norms, customized using the Center's digital self-studying procedures. At the same time, the interests of the executor are consistent with the interests of the Center due to the motivation of the executor to minimize costs.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Logic and Econometrics Methods for Information Security Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper provides an overview of publications devoted to the assessment methods of information security risks in various systems, including those with network structures and using cloud technologies. The authors propose the combined method using fuzzy logic and regression analysis, which allows solving the problem of assessing information security risk in conditions of uncertainty of the dependence of various parameters in complex information structures. It also allows you to identify the parameters on which the information security risk depends to a greater extent, and a list of parameters that you can ignore in the assessed situation.

articleTitle: Information Aspects of the Research of the Spatial Economy of Russia Based on Interregional Interindustry Models
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers methodological issues of construction and information support of models of spatial development of the Russian economy. The relevance of using such models is due to the need to obtain estimates of not only the dynamics of industry indicators, but also to substantiate potential changes in the spatial structure of the economy. Over time, there is a need to modernize the tools used - interregional inter-industry models - in order to use new capabilities of computer technology, adapt to new versions of the system of national accounts and take into account the wishes and requirements of actual and potential customers. Another aspect is the expansion of the range of tasks to be solved, which requires not only changes in the composition of the regions represented, but also adjustments to the mathematical formulation of the models and the structure of the modeling and software complex used.

articleTitle: Modeling the Distributions of Soil Parameters Along the Route of the Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Utilizing information from stratigraphic columns, encompassing soil type, composition, and physical properties such as strength, density, permeability, and water-carrying capacity, we constructed a dataframe. By indexing the dataframe along the distance and depth axes, we derived a non-uniform grid displaying soil layer thickness and soil code. Subsequent analysis involved the development of deterministic and probabilistic models to understand spatial variability. The application of deterministic models is found to diminish the reliability of geological calculations. In contrast, the probabilistic model, backed by diverse correlations, provides a more comprehensive understanding of the relationship between soil type and soil layer thickness along the distance and depth. To quantify the similarity between probability distributions of soil characteristics we built a map of Hellinger distances between soil layer thickness and soil code.

articleTitle: Calculation of Asymptotic Covariance Matrices of M-estimates in the Exponential Autoregressive Model
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This work is dedicated to the calculation of asymptotic covariance matrices of M -estimates in the Ozaki model, using the Huber function as an example. M-estimation methods generalize the least squares and least absolute deviations methods, thus providing more flexible and robust solutions resistant to outliers.

articleTitle: Increasing the Continuity of Centralized Heating Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The significant problems of centralized heat supply systems including major accidents in heating networks and low quality of heat supply to consumers are shown. It is proposed to supplement the centralized heat supply system with a new facility - an active heating point with an automatic control system, which will solve these problems.

Author Keywords: automatic control system continuity of heat supply

articleTitle: Orchestration of Machine Learning Models to Solves Spatial Data Analysis Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This article presents the research results on the architectures and components of machine learning model orchestration systems aimed at solving problems of spatial data analysis. The stages of the life cycle of models are considered, and the critical components of orchestration systems, as well as their functionality, are identified. An orchestrator architecture is proposed, including the considered components and a diagram of their interaction. During the study, more than fifty different scenarios were developed regarding the operating processes of the orchestration system being developed.

articleTitle: Can the Effects of Internet Shutdowns be Estimated Separately from Their Causes? Simulation-Based Inference in the Context of Difference-in-Differences Models
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We propose a simulation-based approach based on the difference-in-differences model for estimating the causal effects of Internet shutdowns. Using synthetic data, we show that researchers can be largely agnostic about the underlying factors that led to Internet shutdowns when estimating their effects.

articleTitle: A Method for Rapid Risk Assessment of a Fog Computing System with a Star-Shaped Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Fog computing solutions significantly reduce communication delays in IoT-based cybersystems. They enable the development of large-scale IoT systems for transport, energy, and smart cities. Such an infrastructure must be highly secure. Therefore, risk management problems are actual there. One of the crucial features of fog computing networks is dynamic topology. Common approaches to cybersecurity do not consider topology change because many computer networks cannot be altered in this way just for security reasons. When managing the fog computing network a security specialist should know how its overall security changes with topology altering because understanding the extent and mechanism of topology's impact on fog computing system security increases the effect of security improvement costs. This study utilizes findings related to the impact of complex systems' structures on their overall risk to address enhancements in fog computing network security. It examines upper bounds of risk deviation for an approximate solution concerning the optimal placement of network nodes in a star-shaped topology and introduces a method for swift risk assessment in a fog computing network with this kind of topology.

articleTitle: Digital Twins in the Context of Industry 5.0
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The report outlines a conceptual and practical approach to establishing the operational framework of digital twins (DTs) within Industry 5.0. It examines the procedure for the development and utilization of cognitive shell-metamodels, which enables the creation, correction, scaling, and deployment of DTs productions and their products of any complexity. The method of cognitive metamodelling for DTs integrates the core properties of DTs software, including 3D modeling, tracking of operational and dynamic changes, configuration management, monitoring of communication relationships, calculation of mass and inertial characteristics, and storage and visualization of chronicles for all operational and dynamic activities. This comprehensive approach enhances the flexibility of the interaction chain: human - DTs - communication channel - physical object, thereby bridging the gap between development, deployment, and scaling stages. In the context of Industry 5.0, applying such cognitive metamodels for DTs can bring all stakeholders involved in development and operation closer together in terms of time and location.

articleTitle: Comparison of Information Transmission Systems for Hydrobionts Using Signals of Different Modalities
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article compares the efficiency of mono-and bimodal systems of information transmission to hydrobionts in terms of its quantity. To achieve this goal, mathematical models of mono-and bimodal systems of information transmission to hydrobionts are used, and simulation modeling and experimental research of these systems are carried out. As a result of the study, the following results were obtained: the bimodal system is more efficient, which is also determined by the type and method of information transmission. The results of the research can be used to develop new methods and improve existing technical systems for transmitting information.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Behavior of a Three-dimensional Epidemic Model
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The behavior of trajectories of a three-dimensional model of an epidemic in a closed environment is considered. The model describes the dynamics of populations of predators and victims, taking into account that predators are infected. The conditions under which the system has internal equilibrium positions are found. Numerically constructed the localizing set for the case of two interior rest points.

articleTitle: Models of the Relationship Between Settlement Systems and Systems of Urban and Suburban Air Mobility
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Simple mathematical models describing the influence of speed and cost of transportation on rational settlement decisions are proposed. Threshold values of parameters of urban and suburban air mobility technologies are determined, at which becomes possible the transition to free settlement within agglomerations with sizes of the order of hundreds of kilometers

Author Keywords: models of transport and settlement interrelation

articleTitle: Optimal Control Problem for Simple Model of Collective Action Campaign
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper studies the optimal control problem for a simple model of collective action campaign. The dynamics of turnout is described by an ordinary differential equation. The optimal control problem is analysed using Pontryagin's maximum principle.

articleTitle: The Financial Sector Network Security Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: SIP vulnerabilities are common cybercrime activities that cause significant losses in the financial sector. There are inherent security issues. The article discusses the mechanisms for ensuring the security of SIP networks and conducting an analysis of the vulnerabilities of this protocol. Recommendations have been formulated to ensure the security of the mentioned protocol.

articleTitle: Comparison of Two Methods to Control a Two-Link Manipulator Based on a Block Approach Without Solving the Inverse Kinematics Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper proposes two control laws for a two-link manipulator that does not require solving the inverse kinematics problem. The first control law provides asymptotic convergence of the tracking error assuming that all parameters of the plant are known. The second method stabilizes the tracking error at a given accuracy in the presence of uncertainties.

articleTitle: National Innovation Systems (NIS) of the Ecosystem Type: Monitoring the Possibilities of Managing Their Development
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The main disadvantages of NIS development management and the prospects of an ecosystem approach for forming an effective NIS are identified.

articleTitle: Selection of Models of the Internal Structure of Mars According to the Chandler Period
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Numerical calculation of the Chandler wobble period of Mars for a set of the internal structure models has been performed. Calculated models satisfy tidal Love number <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k_{2}$</tex>, the moment of inertia value, and the values of parameters derived from the results of the seismic experiment in 2019–2022. Among the rheological models, Andrade model was chosen to account for the viscoelastic behavior of the interior.

articleTitle: Structural Shifts Assessment in the Russian Energy Sector Using the Input-Output Model of the World Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Structural shifts in the energy sector of Russia for the period 2000–2018 are analyzed, taking into account global supply chains. A modification of the author's model of the input-output model of the world economy is proposed. The leading role of energy resources production and processing is shown. An economic justification is given. The model was tested using data from the Federal State Statistics Service and the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.

articleTitle: Features of Navigation Algorithms for Different Types of Uncrewed Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper deals with the peculiarities of navigation algorithms for uncrewed vehicles operating in airspace, on land and water surfaces, and underwater. These peculiarities are due to the available means of measuring navigational parameters, motion models, and communication capabilities between the vehicles. An example illustrates the information processing in an inertial navigation system.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Computing the Parameters of a Low-Impact Sonic Boom Demonstrator Aircraft in Accordance with Specified Technical Requirements During Preliminary Aerodynamic Design Under Epistemic Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: An algorithm for calculating the aerodynamic layout and power plant parameters according to specified technical requirements (TR) at the stage of preliminary aerodynamic design (PAD) has been developed. A low-impact sonic boom demonstrator aircraft X-59 was chosen as a model. We use the uncertainty theory to account for non-deterministic data.

articleTitle: Solving the Aircraft Landing Problem Using Deep Q-Networks Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the Aircraft Landing Problem (ALP) for the static single runway case and proposes a novel approach based on Deep Q-Networks reinforcement learning algorithm. The proposed approach has the potential to provide real-time solutions for optimizing aircraft arrival systems at destination airports.

articleTitle: Method for Finding an Investment Strategy in the Case of a Sparse Covariance Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: An optimality principle is proposed for making investment decisions based on efficiency and risk assessments with a sparse covariance matrix. The method is implemented as a program with a graphical interface and demonstrated using actual stock market data.

articleTitle: Modeling of Stochastic Traffic Flow Through an Intersection with Cluster Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A method is being developed for computer modeling of traffic at a controlled intersection of urban roads. The model represents the traffic as a random process and is based on the use of statistical data for headways in clusters of vehicles. The proposed model explicitly considers the spatiotemporal structure of traffic flow, systematically considering the interdependencies between vehicle passages through conflicting intersection and junction points and on exit roads. The proposed approach can be used to analyze the current passage of flows and to select a method for structural-parametric control of an intersection.

articleTitle: Methodological Provisions for Assessing the Inertia of the Decision-Making Process in Group Control at the Station Level
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The problems arising in solving the optimization problems of the station and block levels of TPP control within the framework of an intelligent automated process control system built on the basis of modern PTC are considered. It is shown that at the same time, within the framework of group control of equipment operating modes, the information support of the automated process control system requires modernization of technical and software controls, alternative approaches to solving this problem are given. The main attention is paid to the development of methodological provisions and an algorithm based on them to assess the inertia of the load control process with proactive control on the example of the problem of optimal distribution of the electric load of a thermal power plant with a given composition of generating equipment. An expert assessment of inertia in solving the problem of optimal load distribution is given.

articleTitle: NPP Upper Level Control System Databases: The Problem of Making Changes
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In present-day industrial control systems responsible for effective and safe operation of nuclear power plants (NPP), the databases of the upper level playa crucial role in process monitoring and control as they acquire, process, and present to the operator the data from all the lower-level systems. Moreover, the air-gapped separation of the upper level makes them extremely valuable for the entire manufacturing management. The specific feature that should be taken into account when dealing with databases of upper level control systems is that they are not perfectly stable and due to the modifications being introduced in lower-level systems subject to changes at all stages of the life cycle. The problem of making changes to the databases combining information of all lower-level devices and so being highly complicated happens to be particularly serious. The article considers the databases of NPP upper level control systems and delves into the problem of making changes to them. A brief overview of the upper level control system illustrating the importance of databases is presented. The description of working databases is provided, their characteristic features are highlighted and the basic principles of the methods for making changes to them are disclosed.

articleTitle: Approach to Identifying Critical Combinations of Events and Parameters in Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We suggest an analytical method for finding the crucial combinations of parameters that enhance the performance of a complex system. These combinations are determined by solving the task of improving a quality indicator. The goal is to identify actions that can enhance development predictions and make the likelihood of favorable outcomes for complex systems higher.

articleTitle: A Model for Assessing the Contribution of Manufacturing Exports to Russian Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The study examines the effect of manufacturing exports on economic growth in Russia and attempts to determine its contribution to the growth of gross output. The OECD Inter-Country Input-Output Tables (ICIO) for 2018, the version of 2021, are used. About 20 friendly countries have been identified as potential importers. Gross output growth rate estimates for all sectors of the Russian economy were obtained.

articleTitle: Calculations Features in Problems of Aircraft and Spacecraft Groups Management
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The distinctive features and competitive advantages of transformative associative memory subprocessors in solving the main and related problems of controlling the group behavior of aircraft and spacecraft are considered.

Author Keywords: control of groups of aircraft and spacecraft

articleTitle: Mechanisms for Managing Socialization Processes Neural Networks Using Prompt Engineering Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Based on the concept of mechanisms for managing the processes of socialization of innovative technologies of industrial engineering carried out a sociological study by the method of a full-scale experiment. The purpose of the study is to determine the regulatory mechanism for the correction of socio-communicative and moral components in the process of conducting training processes of neural networks. Hypothesis tested, including recognition by a technical subject of good and evil in the processes of communication interaction, producing by the neural network of subsequent semantic patterns into the social space. Concluded on compliance of the moral component of the built dialogue with the Generative neural network Pretrained Transformer 3.5 by civilizational norms of society in a specific experiment. At the same time, the problem of the need to build socialization institutions in the technosubjects learning processes is indicated due to the widespread possibilities of building neural networks by everyone interested.

articleTitle: Competitiveness Russian Metallurgical Business in the Global Steel Market
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors have identified patterns and assessed the competitive advantages of Russian business development in the metallurgical sector of the country's economy and performed a comparative analysis of domestic steel production with similar production in the leading countries of the world metallurgy. Based on the analysis of retrospective information on the market concentration and indicators of liquid steel production in the TOP 10 countries, as well as the gross domestic product of these countries for 2009–2023. Data have been obtained to assess the potential business development opportunities in the metallurgical sector of the domestic and global economy. The estimated indicators of competitive relations between the Russian steelmaking sector and the corresponding production in the TOP 10 countries in terms of direct competition - absolute entropy and indirect - the Hirfendahl-Hirschman index in 2009–2023 have been established. The general trend towards monopolization in the production and economic sphere of the metallurgical sector of the world economy has been identified and the prospect of a positive positioning of the domestic steel cluster in the global development of metallurgy has been assessed.

articleTitle: The Technology of Constructing Generalized Risk Factor Assessment of Objects on the Resulting Ordinal Scale Considering their Expert Probability
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the technology of constructing generalized risk factor for evaluation of objects considering their expert probability, including technical projects, enterprise development strategies, construction of regional facilities, and so on. The construction of a generalized risk factor assessment of objects with a multi-level structure results an issue of constructing the resulting scale. The relative degree of losses is generally characterized by weights of risk factors. The level of risk consequences and respective subjective probability are usually presented as the form of a square matrix - a risk map. Risks areas with verbal interpretation are accepted as a generalized assessment. The article proposes a new method for transitioning from the initial assessment of risk factors considering the expert probability to point estimates on the resulting difference scale based on the technology framework of constructing a generalized risk assessment of objects with a multi-level structure. The essence of the method is originally reduced to the transition from the initial point estimates in the point scale to the interval gradations of the resulting scale. Subsequently, given the subjective probability, one transits to point estimates of the resulting difference scale.

articleTitle: The Feasibility of Using a Predictive Neural Network Controller in the Problem of Maintaining the Water Level in a Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of the results of using a predictive neuro-regulator developed in the MATLAB environment and using a neural network to correct the control signal of a hydraulic laboratory stand with a classical PI regulator in the task of maintaining the water level in a tank. The feasibility of using this approach has also been assessed. The results obtained can shed light on the advantages and limitations of using neuro-regulators using the example of a hydraulic bench.

Author Keywords: maintaining the water level in the tank

articleTitle: On Control Problems with Degenerate Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, we study control problems with mixed constraints. We consider a very general regularity condition, which is sufficient for the existence of local admissible controls.

articleTitle: The Model Law “On Digital Healthcare”: Problems and Prospects of Development in the Post-SOVIET Space
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The world is on the verge of tremendous changes, moving from the post-industrial period to an economy based on digital and nanotechnology. Russia is actively pursuing strategies aimed at developing the digital economy and, in particular, digital innovations in healthcare. These innovations open up new opportunities for healthcare not only in Russia, but also in the CIS countries. After the collapse of the USSR, there has been diversity in the development of digital technologies in healthcare in the former Soviet republics. Currently, efforts to expand the electronic medical infrastructure are becoming a major component of the strategic initiatives of the CIS countries. An analysis of national strategies in this area for the near and long term shows that most CIS countries have already developed specific plans for the introduction of information and communication technologies in healthcare. The level of Internet accessibility (IA) in the CIS countries varies significantly: from extremely low in Turkmenistan (IA=1), average in Ukraine (IA=3), to above average in Azerbaijan (IA=4), Armenia (IA=4), Belarus (IA=4) and high in Kazakhstan (IA=5), Moldova (IA=5), Tajikistan (IA=5), Uzbekistan (IA=5), as well as the highest in Russia (IA=6). In the Russian Federation, 95% of medical institutions are connected to the network, of which 83.4% of hospitals and about 60% of all medical institutions have broadband access. In other CIS countries, this indicator corresponds to the regional average. One of the key indicators of the effectiveness of government actions in the field of digital medicine is the integration of projects on the widespread use of information and communication technologies into national strategies and action plans. The study shows that the countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States differ in the level of implementation and integration of information and communication technologies. Tajikistan is characterized by the least integration activity (IA=3), while Kazakhstan, Moldova and Russia demonstrate the highest activity (IA=6). Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan are next in terms of integration (IA=5), while Armenia and Ukraine occupy the middle position (IA=4). The average IA for the CIS countries is 4.82. In this regard, the interaction of the CIS states in the field of public health is becoming crucial, especially taking into account the social priorities of post-Soviet countries focused on the preservation of rights and freedoms, management of large-scale migration flows, transparency of borders, creation of a single economic space, as well as humanitarian and cultural cooperation between the countries. This is also due to the desire of society for social solidarity, ensuring a certain level of social protection, supporting equal opportunities and combating social exclusion and discrimination on any grounds.

articleTitle: Modernization of the Digital Platform for Incident Management in the Moscow Economy System Based on Artificial Intelligence Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The key components of the architecture of the digital incident management platform of the Urban Services Complex are presented: information field, monitoring systems and data analysis, modules for processing and moderating information, classification, decision-making based on artificial intelligence (AI) methods. The directions for increasing the accuracy and speed of response to incidents through social media are emphasized.

articleTitle: Options for Martian Magnetic Field Modelling from Satellite Data Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The Martian magnetic field, characterized by its complex and heterogeneous structure, poses significant challenges for modeling due to the inaccessibility of the planet's interior and noisy satellite data. This study presents an iterative approach using the S-approximation method, a robust analytical method for handling large but fragmented data sets from orbital missions on Mars. By representing the magnetic field as a sum of fields generated by simple and double layers on predefined surfaces, this method allows for the construction of high-resolution models that reflect the observed magnetic field. The approach allows for flexible selection of carrier geometries (planes, dihedral angles, spheres, ellipsoids) to accommodate different study scales and problem geometries, facilitating the modeling of local and global magnetic anomalies. By choosing different model parameters and integrating different data sets, this approach improves the accuracy and spatial coverage of Martian magnetic field models.

articleTitle: The Study of Possible Concepts, Application Scenarios and the Formation of the Appearance of a Promising Aircraft-Type UAV with a Take-Off Weight of Up to 5400 kg
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the main implementation options and concepts for the use of a promising aircraft-type UAV. Based on the analysis of the key points of the airworthiness standards of unmanned aircraft systems, the key factors that will determine the appearance and characteristics of the future product are selected. Based on the analysis of the market, as well as aircraft analogues, the main layout solutions have been formed, as well as the requirements for flight performance have been determined. An analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of various concepts has been carried out and, based on it, the best application option has been selected, the appearance of the product has been formed for this option.

articleTitle: Strategic Adaptive Transport Management
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A modular approach to strategic adaptive management of the transport complex has been developed based on actual and target values of key indicators of its efficiency. The functioning mechanisms of the modules used are based on digital learning procedures. The developed approach is illustrated using the example of optimal synthesis of the functioning mechanism of the Newbie module.
