articleTitle: The Problem of Global Energy Flow Management
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper examines the global energy flow model that covers the full supply chain of internationally traded energy and goods. The dynamics of changes in the picture of global energy flows in the 21st century are analyzed. The paper identifies the main sectors of the economy that contribute to the carbon footprint and determines the historical redistribution of global energy flows. OECD (TiVA) data are used to analyze energy flows.

articleTitle: An Approach to Digitalization of Multilinear Models
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses the problem of digital representation of multilinear models. The method uses a tabular form of their description, which includes sections of variables, monomials, and multilinear functions. It automatically generates a mathematical programming problem. Digital representation allows you to introduce a binary relationship between multilinear models according to the “weakening” principle.

articleTitle: Source Code Obfuscation Assessment Techniques for Remote Financial Services
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The results of a study of the possibilities of using software obfuscation tools in the financial sector are presented. The modern most common means of obfuscation, methods, and criteria for assessing their quality are considered. A developed methodology for comparing and selecting obfuscators to ensure the information security of remote financial services is proposed. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Construction of Guaranteeing Controls in the Simplest Export Enterprise Model
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the simplest model of an export enterprise operating under uncertainty. The set of possible values of uncertain factors is specified using a scenario tree. Optimization problems for finding guaranteeing controls are stated. Their solution is demonstrated using a numerical example.

articleTitle: Use of Deep Learning Methods for Prognostics and Health Management of Aircraft Engines
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Approaches to detecting data anomalies using autoencoders and predicting the remaining useful life of aircraft engines using data-driven deep learning models are reviewed. The problem of planning aircraft engine maintenance based on reinforcement learning is considered.

articleTitle: Scientific Research Transformation Needed for Comprehensive Artificial Intelligence Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper deals with complementary changes in scientific research and real economy (exemplified by the farming industry) taking place when using the holistic approach to the industry”s digital transformation resulting in the appearance of precise agrarian technologies that require a comprehensive., system-based combination of research and production resources that are able to ensure increased productivity in the industry. We demonstrate that among these new technologies, the artificial intelligence methods have a special significance. They have to, however, go through integration transformations to become standards for the proposed common digital farming management platform.

articleTitle: A Production Model for Calculating Pollutant Concentration Considering the Influence of Precipitation Washout and Dry Deposition
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents the results of developing a mathematical model for computer simulation and study of the processes of atmospheric pollutant dispersion, taking into account various factors, including data on known emission sources, meteorological conditions, and monitoring results of pollutant concentrations at specific points in an industrial area. Gaussian and Ermak models were considered as the basic mathematical models for pollutant dispersion. The developed model has been implemented as a computer program that allows for automated simulation iterations based on actual measurements of the environmental situation and weather conditions in a specified area. Calculations and a comparative assessment of the accuracy of the proposed model were carried out using the program, and conclusions were drawn confirming its effectiveness for simulating pollutant dispersion in the atmosphere.

articleTitle: Efficiency Comparison of Feature Processing Methods in Early Diagnostics Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article proposes to consider methods of early diagnosis and classification of the technical condition of the aircraft unit. The main purpose of the article is to compare different types of time signal analysis methods – general purpose methods and statistical methods - to assess their effectiveness in classifying the technical condition of an electromechanical drive.

articleTitle: On One Model of Research Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A simple model of planning research (scientific, industrial, etc.) is proposed, taking into account a number of requirements related to the conditions that Center or Coordinator sets out in advance. Competitive participation of performers is allowed. The research is conducted taking into account a number of restrictions (preservation of specific institutions, consideration of employee qualifications), a criterion is formulated.

articleTitle: Assessment of Digital Connectivity in Russian Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Universal digital connectivity as a result of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) application is considered as one of the most objective aspects of the digitalization of the economy and society. The comparison of its level between countries is complemented by the corresponding measurement results for the regions of the Russian Federation. This makes it possible to determine the variability of universal digital connectivity at the subnational level and position regions among many other countries and their regions. The results obtained can be used by researchers and decision makers to measure digital inequality and identify factors that determine the level of digital connectivity in order to ensure effective regional digital development.

articleTitle: Analysis and Management of Large-Scale Programs Under Sanctions
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The strategic planning system of the Russian Federation widely uses program-target planning methods to achieve target development indicators for individual sectors and industries of the economy. The report examines the tasks of analyzing and forecasting the degree of achievability of target indicators of development programs under sanctions. We propose an approach to solving this problem, based on the construction of simulation models that make it possible to simulate material and financial flows over the periods of the program for various scenarios of sanctions restrictions. This approach allows us to numerically assess the impact of identified risks and changes in scenario conditions on the target indicators of the program. As part of the study, multifactor calculations were carried out to analyze the achievability of the target indicators of the “Comprehensive Program for the Development of the Air Transport Industry of the Russian Federation until 2030,” which are illustrated with numerical examples.

articleTitle: Practical Proposals to Ensure the National Goals of the Russian Federation and the Implementation of Programs and Development Plans for 6 Years and a Forecast for 12 Years
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: An analysis of the features of the 6-year planning period including new ambitious goals set by the President of the Russian Federation showed that there are possible scenarios in which these goals may be unachievable in comparison with significant limitations of current practice. A Proposal is presented that can prevent this threat.

articleTitle: Exploratory Search and Evaluation of the Initial Effectiveness of Autonomous Solutions and Guided Integration Components
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This report considers the potential of utilising novel hybrid models of data envelopment analysis technology to describe the coordination of actions and evaluate the effectiveness of prosumers. The main emphasis is on the thorough analysis of autonomous systems, taking into account the special challenges associated with simulating the perception, observation, and exchange of information amongst various control objects. The report partially reflects some trends from the regular scientific seminar “Control Science of Autonomous Systems,” explaining relevant areas of both theoretical and applied research.

articleTitle: Dynamic Differentiation of Deterministic Signals of One Class
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Forestimation of derivatives of continuous composite signals described by fragments of algebraic polynomials, an observer with piecewise continuous corrections with saturation is developed. They provide asymptotically accurate differentiation and substantially constrain the spikes of the observer variables at the beginning of transients compared to an observer with conventional linear correction.

articleTitle: Scenario Modeling in Security Management of Complex Organizational Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper discusses the challenges associated with enhancing the effectiveness of managing Russia's national security in the context of information. The fundamental levels of security provision are identified and an examination of the primary areas of advancement in scenario analysis and modeling technique as a tool for decision support is conducted. The outcomes of the advancement of instruments for the automation of scenario analysis are summarized.

articleTitle: The University of a Complete Innovation Cycle as a Promising Model for the Large-Scale Scientific and Educational Ecosystems Development
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In the world and in Russian Federation, there is a constant search for new forms of educational process that would meet the modern requirements of digitalization of industry, science and society. Universities play a significant role in this process, as centers of intellectual resources attraction. The purpose of this article is to analyze the prerequisites for the new university model of a complete innovation cycle formation in the context of sustainable development.

articleTitle: Bagging in the Lack of Reproducibility of Neural Network Results
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: by changing the parameter of the pseudo-random optimization process of the neural network, we generate several variants of training the neural network when solving the classification problem. From them, we obtain bagging - an average solution less susceptible to overfitting. We give an example of performing such bagging and compare it with the classification method based on the Anderson discriminant function and the identically related posterior probability of the class.

articleTitle: An Improvement of the Tactile-Proprioceptive Feedback System for the Myoelectric Prosthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents an information system that implements the feedback principle for a virtual myoelectric prosthesis. This system can control a virtual hand using muscle activity. Using a new communication channel makes it possible to improve the ergonomics and functionality of myoelectric prostheses.

articleTitle: Performance Comparative Analysis of OvA, AvA, and OvO Algorithms in Multi-Class Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper presents the result of comparative analysis of the main approaches to multi-class classification, synthesis of their mathematical models based on the considered algorithms is carried out. Their features, advantages, and disadvantages are presented, and the accuracy of multi-class classification is evaluated. Their features, advantages, and disadvantages are presented, and the accuracy of multi-class classification is evaluated. The dependence on accuracy and computational resource requirements is shown. The OvA algorithm can be a better way to solve problems with a small number of classes and limited resources. For tasks that require high classification accuracy and sufficient computational resources, AvA or OvO algorithms can be chosen. Synthesis of mathematical models and systematic generalization was carried out.

articleTitle: Accuracy of Determining Damage from Atmosphere Pollution by Industry Under Various Combinations of Events
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article develops a mathematical model that allows us to consider the influence of critical combinations of events solving the problem of minimizing damage from the impact of air pollutants on the population, agriculture and the environment. The results obtained can be used to improve environmental monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Quality of Linear Regression on Principal Components Constructed by Robust and Classical Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A linear regression model with correlated regressors having a contaminated Gaussian distribution is considered. To overcome multicollinearity, the method of constructing regression on principal components is used, using robust methods for constructing principal components. The influence of the magnitude of regressor contamination on the coefficient of determination is studied using stochastic modeling.

Author Keywords: robust estimators of the correlation matrix

articleTitle: Mathematical Algorithms for Containers Area
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A formal description of the container area and the railway front of the terminal and logistics center is given. The problems of rearranging containers and loading trains with the least number of crane movements are formulated. Formal definitions of concepts are given in terms of set theory, and movement planning algorithms are presented. Possible deadlock situations in the operation of some algorithms have been identified (Abstract)

articleTitle: Towards an Adaptive Plant Population Model
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The behavior of a very general model of plant population biomass growth is studied, which maximizes productivity in the final time period under conditions of a constant external environment. The Bellman equation is formulated and used to describe the optimal controls of the model.

articleTitle: Normative Aspects of Unification of Means of Ensuring Functional Reliability of Technological System
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A methodological approach to ensuring the reliability of the technological operations system in accordance with the norms determining of the functional blocks unification of proposed the production line. Taking into account the content of the labor process, as well as the peculiarities of functional blocks operation, the proposed approach consider as a basis for ensuring of profile standards the effectiveness in technological systems.

articleTitle: Formal Model for the average Request Processing Time in a Real- Time Data Processing System
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This work addresses the problems of analysis and synthesis of software and data ware for distributed data processing systems operating in real time. The paper presents formal models and algorithms for calculating the average and maximum processing time of various requests.

Author Keywords: average and maximum request processing time in the system

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical System Development to Improve Energy Supply on Transport by Causal Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Modern systems may be considered as cyber-physical ones. It assumes variety of devices, automatically executing control. Widely propagated neural networks are applicable to causal models. Some aspects of the mathematical support to co-develop nets of energy, transport, communication are presented that may be usefiul for other systems.

articleTitle: The Decomposition of the Control Problem for Wheeled Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This work is devoted to the study of the singularly perturbed control problem for a mobile wheeled robot. Using of a geometric approach and asymptotic expansions allows us to separate slow and fast subsystems. Slow subsystem becomes independent. Fast subsystem describes rapidly decaying transient processes. This approach simplifies the system structure and reduces the order of the problem.

articleTitle: Vehicle Cruise Control with Lane Keeping Based on Measuring the Speed Vector and Trajectory Curvature Using Microwave Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article discusses a model of automatic vehicle control for collision avoidance and lane keeping. The controller uses longitudinal velocity, lateral deflection, and yaw angle as input parameters. The data for calculating these values comes from microwave Doppler sensors located on the rear wheels of the vehicle. A camera-based sensor transmits data to the system about the predicted section of the centerline at the current moment in time. Frequency modulated microwave radar measures the distance to an object and its rate of approach. All the listed parameters enter to the input of the system. The output parameters of the control system are acceleration and steering wheel angle.

articleTitle: Dynamic Optimization of Production Activities with Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the problems of dynamic optimization of production activities with learning effect. Analytical solutions of optimal control problems using the Pontryagin<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">,</sup>s maximum principle are obtained. Optimal strategies for choosing optimal production and work volumes are found.

articleTitle: System Dynamic Model for Evaluating the Information Modules Quality of ERP-Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper considers the quality management of ERP systems. A mathematical model based on a system-dynamic approach has been developed for the analysis of 21 parameters from ISO 25010 using AnyLogic. The model improves the assessment of the feasibility and maintenance of ERP systems.

articleTitle: Nonlinear System Changes in Economic Processes and Approaches to Management in Conditions of Nonlinear Changes
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Economic processes are characterized by abrupt, systemic changes in their dynamics and correlation models. The unique role of such periods in dynamics requires the development of tools that, on the one hand, will allow us to identify changes and manage risks. On the other hand, they should ensure the flexibility of economic systems and lay the groundwork for future changes.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Acoustic Emission in Rocks Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A comprehensive analysis of the spectral features of acoustic emissions in rock samples has been undertaken, employing advanced machine learning algorithms. Findings suggest that these data analysis methods enable the automated identification of events, enhance the precision in frequency estimation, and facilitate the prediction of potential seismic activity with greater accuracy.

articleTitle: Equilibrium in Allen Type Dynamic Market Model
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper we investigate dynamic equilibrium of a dynamic Evans-Samuelson-Walras model. We show that dynamic equilibrium existence is connected with general equi-librium existence. To obtain the sufficient conditions of dynamic equilibrium existence for the considered model we use the results of covering maps and coincidence points theory.

articleTitle: Conformal Prediction Model for Enterprise Economic Indicators
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A model for forecasting economic performance of enterprises using conformal predictors to assess the confidence of the forecast is presented. Conformal predictors provide individual prediction intervals by estimating data and model uncertainty, which is particularly important in economic forecasts. It is shown that the average confidence of revenue forecasting models is independent of business size, whereas the confidence variance is higher for medium-sized businesses. This can be used to identify incorrect reporting. It is also revealed that forecasting the total revenue of a group of enterprises within a single SIC code can increase the confidence of the models.

articleTitle: Modeling of Long-Term Development of the Russian Gas Industry Under Conditions of Multidimensional Energy Transition
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the peculiarities of optimization modeling of long-term development of the Russian gas industry in the conditions of multidimensional energy transition. It describes the ways of energy transition in the whole production chain: geological exploration, production, processing, storage, liquefaction, and transportation of gas.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Cost Management System for Preventive Measures in the Technological Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The system of enterprises participating in the technological chain is considered. The Centre is the producer of the final product and the consumer of the resources produced by the agents. The article considers options for interaction between the center and agents regarding management costs of preventive measures. The problem of covering costs for preventive measures in the system has been formulated and solved.

articleTitle: Software Agent for Organizing Calculations in Large-Scale Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper considers the requirements of software agents for organizing distributed computing in large-scale control systems based on MLOps. MLOps approaches and tools for implementing machine-learning models in real production processes are presented. The paper proposes a standard software agent for organizing a network of multi-agent distributed computing systems.

articleTitle: Use of Expected Interest Rate in Forecasting Commodity Prices
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper focuses on forecasting nominal commodity prices from different commodity sectors (including prices of agricultural raw materials, prices of metals and prices of energy commodities) using VAR models. We use federal funds futures to measure the interest rate expectations. Based on our literature review it has been discovered that the expected interest rate is rarely used in forecasting commodity prices. Monthly data from December 1997 to October 2021 have been used in this analysis. The forecast evaluation results have been obtained using different technics including MAPE, the Diebold-Mariano (DM) tests. The results of out-of-sample forecasting experiments allow us to draw two conclusions. First, an expected interest rate may be used in forecasting models instead of actual interest rates as it helps to improve forecasting accuracy for most commodities. Second, the VAR model based on monetary variables delivers significantly better forecasts than the benchmark model, which is a random walk model.

articleTitle: Aspects of Developing Applied Parametric Identification Methods for Digital Substations
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The authors consider that the Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) used at digital substations create conditions for effectively applying the parametric identification method. We present the mathematical formulation of the parametric identification problem for PMUs. The authors propose a practical method for estimating the unknown parameters of a PMU mathematical model with a two-stage generalized least squares method.

articleTitle: An Approach to the Organization of Distributed Processing Based on the Network Generalization of Unix Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The principles of organizing the new network service, designed to implement the pipelined data processing in a multi-server environment, are considered. The main idea of the approach is to remove pipeline processing from client workstations to servers and use it to organize multi-server processing of information queries in distributed systems. The results of measuring the processing rate of the service are presented.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model for Forecasting Quality of Life in the Region
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A mathematical model has been developed to analyze and forecast quality of life indicators in the region. Using the model, scenarios for the development of the economy of the Saratov region in 2023–2028 were analyzed.

articleTitle: Risk of Deep Drilling: Seismic Velocities Estimate for Skjalfandi Bay, Iceland Based on Selected Coordinate Descent
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In oil-gas production and other industries, drilling of boreholes provides information about geophysical and geo-chemical signs of energy sources within the Earth. However, the inhomogeneous structure of the crust creates technical challenges for the deep drilling process. In this paper for the first time, we present the seismic velocity model calculated owing to the application of the selected coordinate descent method for the area of Skjalfandi Bay, northern Iceland in the range of 5–10 km, which is more profound than that for conventional drilling. Indicators of potential placement of deposits of oil and gas characterize the area. Namely, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons are detected in the fault zones, and high concentrations of methane of biogenic origin are revealed in rock samples that were taken up from the Skjalfandi Bay boreholes. The obtained results might be helpful to determine markers of oil and gas presence in areas of high latitude Arctic including Siberian regions. That is important for the control decisions.

articleTitle: Research Functioning of the Country's Economic System Using Wavelet Analisis of the Consumer Prise Index
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is dedicated to studying the time series reflecting the Consumer Price Index from January 1991 to December 2023 using wavelet analysis. This study utilized the Morlet wavelet (other wavelets provided similar results). The findings reveal significant structural changes within the economic system in 1998, 2014, and 2022, with the 1998 crisis being the most significant event. Analysis of normalized frequencies suggests that there might be substantial changes at the boundaries of the observation period, similar in intensity

articleTitle: Assessment of the Current Local Transport Situation via Online Processing of Monitoring Data and its Application for Traffic Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A new approach to adaptive traffic light control at an intersection is being developed by using automatic control methods while constantly monitoring local traffic flow. Methods of providing it with the necessary data, both characterizing the current local situation and statistical dependencies for the stochastic dynamics of traffic flows, are considered. Methods for obtaining estimates of the values of monitored local traffic indicators are determined. The experience of computer modeling using the proposed method shows the expected reduction in traffic delays, as well as the possibility of choosing the most effective control method for a specific traffic situation.

articleTitle: Financial Characteristics Graphic Representation for Borrowers Coalition in Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper we present the results of numerical experiments on borrowers' coalition model designed for asset purchase. Specific digital data describes housing market. We focused on the visualization of obtained results in order to determine qualitative features of main parameters' dynamics in the coalition equity.

articleTitle: Public Efficiency of Expenditures for Digital Transformation of the Country
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The tasks of digitalization, solved at the expense of state financing, are described. The rules for estimating the cost of information products are proposed. Instead of the criterion of economic efficiency in the form of maximum effect, a criterion is proposed for minimizing costs that solve the tasks set, provided they are calculated according to the established rules.

articleTitle: Continuous DNN Identifier With Barrier Learning Laws for Restricted States Supply Chains Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Supply chains with dynamical behavior (SCD) are significant in the current industrial management. They can help to reduce inventory, enable flow of materials, maximize profits, and minimize costs. Dynamics of SCD is usually represented by a nonlinear perturbed dynamical system with imprecise parameters and limited state vector. The potential application of SCDs in industrial scenarios requires an effective model representation that can be used in a posterior optimization approach. Differential neural networks (DNN) with continuous-time dynamics can be used to obtain a feasible approximate mathematical model of the SCD that can be further used as a part of the optimization approach. This study develops a DNN identifier to approximate the dynamics of SCD considering the limitations on the states. The differential learning laws for the aforementioned neural network, which take into account restrictions on the states, are presented using the concept of barrier Lyapunov functions. A formal analysis that justifies the existence of the barrier learning laws is presented. The explicit implementation of the identifier is explained in detail, high-lighting how particular SCD can be handled with the proposed continuous neural network. A numerically simulated example of a three level continuous-time model of the nonlinear supply chain is evidenced in this study to illustrate the applicability of the proposed identifier for a supply chain with imprecise mathematical description.

articleTitle: Movement at Desired Velocity in the Swarm Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We study the swarm control algorithm based on the metric-topological approach. For the swarm movement in free space, we consider the problem of ensuring a given velocity under the assumption that the swarm is sufficiently aligned in advance. The modes of maintaining a given velocity in the absence of external disturbances are proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Socially-Oriented Model of the Megalopolis Transport Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article includes consideration of the problems of designing megalopolis management facilities from the point of view of the “smart city” concept. The authors describe the design objectives, objects, and management principles, and give a brief overview of smart cities according to the UN. Researchers propose a socially-oriented multi-level model for designing the transport infrastructure of a smart city.

articleTitle: Management of Organizational Territorially Distributed Systems Through Geoportals and Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study aimed at developing technology for the rapid deployment of geoportals to solve the problem of managing geographically distributed organizational systems. Areas of application: optimal use of natural resources, monitoring the development of natural processes, managing the activities of organizations whose resources are distributed over a large territory, monitoring social processes.

articleTitle: About Lognormal Distribution of Some Characteristics of Oil Deposits in the Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Area
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Using data from the “State Register of Oil Reserves” for the Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Area, the laws governing the distribution of reservoir and oil characteristics were studied. It has been shown that permeability, effective oil-saturated thickness of the reservoir, oil-bearing area of the deposits, oil viscosity, and the reserves of oil field deposits are distributed according to a lognormal law.

Author Keywords: effective oil-saturated thickness of the reservoir

articleTitle: Rising Energy Domestic Prices and Russia's Forecast GDP Rates
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The sensitivity of Russia's GDP to the growth of domestic energy prices is studied. The results of the studies showed that electricity and heat prices have the greatest impact on GDP dynamics. The dynamics of energy prices should ensure a balance of interests between energy producers and consumers due to the high sensitivity of GDP to the growth of these prices.

articleTitle: Model for Assessing the Liquidity of a Stock Market Trading Instrument
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Currently, a large number of studies are being conducted to improve the accuracy of the developed forecasting methods for the stock market. At the same time, multivariate models based on machine learning methods are increasingly used. Since liquidity indicators have a significant impact on asset pricing, taking them into account can improve the accuracy of forecasting. The purpose of this study is to develop machine learning models that forecast securities quotes taking into account the liquidity factor, as well as to analyze the impact of liquidity on the accuracy of forecasting various types of securities. Using the example of multivariate models ARIMA and LSTM, a study was conducted of forecast indicators of stock quotes with the addition of a feature time series with liquidity ratios. The results of the study show that taking liquidity into account is of great importance in developing more accurate forecasting methods, which is very important for investors and investment companies.

articleTitle: Development of Geographic Information Systems for Environmental Monitoring Using Ground and Satellite Data
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This article presents the systems of environmental monitoring and forecasting: the system of environmental monitoring of the neighboring territories of the Russian Federation. The systems were created on the basis of Web-GIS-technologies, which made it possible to combine satellite, ground and prognostic information from territorially remote organizations in a single information environment. The user is provided with quick access to the whole array of data for making timely management decisions with the help of an ordinary web-browser. The products of the information systems are used not only for monitoring natural hazards, but also for studying long-term environmental changes.

articleTitle: Resilience of Engineering Distributive Infrastructures
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: An integrated approach to increasing the resilience of engineering distributive infrastructures under destructive impacts is proposed. This approach includes a study of organizational and engineering resilience and analysis of the data flow errors impact in the operational dispatch service on the functioning and productivity of the engineering infrastructure. Models for searching for vulnerabilities and the impact of these vulnerabilities on the uninterrupted provision of services to consumers are considered.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Composition of Educational Tasks for Members of a Student Group in Order to Maximize the Quality of Learning for the Group as a Whole
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A mathematical model is proposed to estimate the amount of studied educational material, taking into account the influence of students' cognitive abilities diversity and experience of educational tasks composition for different group students.

articleTitle: Computational Study of Ground Vortex Formation Near the Subsonic Air Intake
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper emphasizes the relevance of ground vortex formation near the turbofan engine air intake and discusses the potential consequences of the foreign object debris. An analysis was performed to determine the intensity of the vortex flow in the gas-air flow under the air intake. The study is based on previously performed experimental work, which revealed the dependence of the possibility of throwing foreign objects into an aircraft engine on the horizontal speed of the vortex air flow near the ground surface. A series of crosswind speeds were examined to analyze the vortex flow. The influence of crosswind speed on the formation of vortex flow was revealed. The need to develop structural and operational methods to protect turbofan engines from foreign object ingress is noted.

articleTitle: On the Existence and Uniqueness of Global Solutions of Quasilinear Equations
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The work is devoted to first-order quasilinear differential equations with one unknown function, for which the existence and uniqueness of multivalued and classical solutions are studied. It has been established that for multivalued solutions the Cauchy problem has the largest solution, but for classical ones, generally speaking, it does not.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Distributing Resources Between Active Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Models that are prioritized in the actions of the center can be used to analyze control schemes. The interests of active subsystems should be considered in management. Tasks of resource allocation are carried out by the data center in areas of interest. An algorithm for finding the maximum guaranteed center gain is presented when distributing resources between subsystems is given below.

articleTitle: What is the Effect of All-Moving Extended Ventral Fins on the Aircraft Stability and Controllability?
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This article examines how all-moving extended ventral fins affect the aircraft directional stability and controllability.

articleTitle: Optimal Control in the Problem With Two Gas Fields
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We explore a continuous aggregated dynamic model for developing two gas fields. The new borehole commissioning rates are the control parameters. Changes in the average flow rate of producing boreholes and current natural gas production are proportional. It is necessary to solve the problem of maximizing discounted accumulated income for two gas fields. We analyze the optimal control problem with an unrestricted right end and a fixed time. The Pontryagin maximum principle is a main tool for solving the problem. The special optimal control mode is of particular interest. We highlight the critical aspects of all possible optimal controls.

Author Keywords: the aggregated dynamic model of gas field development
the applied problem of optimal control

articleTitle: Aortography Keypoint Tracking Using Recurrent and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A method for tracking key points in aortography using a hybrid model of convolutional and recurrent neural networks is proposed, achieving a classification accuracy of 98% and an average regression error of 4%. This improves the positioning of the aortic valve in the TAVI procedure.

articleTitle: System-Dynamic Model for Analysis and Forecasting Emergency Situations of Oil Refinery Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: A system-dynamic model has been developed for the analysis and forecasting of emergency situations at oil refineries. The model takes into account key safety indicators and external factors, increasing the accuracy of forecasts and improving the safety management systems of the enterprise, reducing the likelihood of accidents and their consequences.

articleTitle: From Digital Management Platform Development to a Computer-Aided Crop Rotation Engineering System in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: Thepaper deals with a formalized description of a computer-aided crop rotation engineering system based on a mathematical crop system optimization model implemented in the digital platform for industry management that would offer an ontological and functional integration of farming industry objectives from the joint science-based point of view. The paper demonstrates that when it comes to the digital economy, crop rotation should be the focal point in precision agriculture that all the farming processes are based on.

articleTitle: Approximation of a Regulator for Discrete Two- Parameter Coupled Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: In this paper, a stabilizing feedback law for a coupled discrete dynamic system with two parameters is proposed based on the use of asymptotic approximations in powers of two parameters and the decomposition of the original system. The proposed method uses the Pade approximations and the SDRE approach. Illustrative numerical experiments are presented.

Author Keywords: stabilizing control in the form of feedback

articleTitle: The Method of Dynamic Compensation in the Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of a method for synthesizing systems with separable motions based on the use of deep feedback and discontinuous control actions, which allows for multiple decomposition of control system synthesis problems into independently solvable subtasks of lower dimension.

articleTitle: An Approach to Soft Linking Capacity Expansion and Dispatch Models to Assess the Flexibility of the Future Energy System Using the Example of the UPS of Russia
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The expected decarbonization of the Russian power system creates challenges that require new complex approaches to modeling its development and functioning. An approach to the soft linking of the capacity expansion and dispatch models is proposed. The results show the effectiveness of the proposed approach in identifying critical issues of the future power system and their elimination.

articleTitle: Electoral Control by Partition Voters Using the Schulze Method
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The paper investigated the application of the Schulze method for voting in small groups from the point of view of the possibility of controlling elections. Several strategies for controlling voting by partition of voters have been described. Their effectiveness has been studied in numerical experiments and on actual data.

articleTitle: Plan Balancing for Active Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: We consider decision making problems for player interaction model in two-level organization system. We state Center request consensus problem and system response in a common case of linear dependencies. We formulate balance conditions in the case of guaranteed consensus and possible good- will of the whole production. We present solution schemes to the mentioned problems and realization proofs.

articleTitle: Thermal Wave Processes of Control the Development of Oil Fields with Abnormally High-Viscosity Reserves
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The efficiency of developing fields with abnormally high-viscosity oil reserves is achieved by using cyclic injection of thermal slugs of hot water and steam (as an active displacement reagent), propelled by slugs of unheated water. For greater efficiency of thermal methods for displacing high-viscosity oil, this paper offers to use thermal methods in combination with embedded emission-wave influences. The article presents the results of experiments using a mathematical model of cylindrical waves in the direction of the filtration flow of fluids. The effectiveness of cyclic control wave influences is shown. Complex problems associated with the application of hydrodynamic methods to weakly discontinuous vibrations in an inhomogeneous medium are noted and ways to resolve them are indicated. It is shown that the proposed combined thermal and vibration-wave control effects on the process of filtration displacement of abnormally high-viscosity oil fractions.

Author Keywords: wave and thermal cyclic control actions

articleTitle: Situational Control Based on Fuzzy Neural Networks in Continuous Production Management
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article considers the problem of continuous production management. The technological process of sheet glass production is chosen as an example. We have analyzed the process of sheet glass forming. We have described the main stages of production. They propose a model based on situational control to develop a control system for glass production.

articleTitle: On the Efficiency of Economic Activity of Small Enterprises Operating in the Field of Ground Passenger Transportation (Code 34 in All-Russian Classifier of Economic Activities OKVED2)
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The aim of the work was to identify factors affecting the total revenue of regional small enterprises operating in the field of ground passenger transportation, and to evaluate the efficiency of these enterprises. This was done using production function and stochastic frontier models. The statistics were taken from the Complete statistical survey of small and medium-sized businesses in 2020.

articleTitle: Theoretical Aspects of Strategic Planning in the Organization and Financing of Healthcare in the Republic of Guinea
publicationTitle: 2024 17th International Conference on Management of Large-Scale System Development (MLSD)
abstract: The article is devoted to the theoretical aspects of strategic planning in the organization and financing of healthcare in the Republic of Guinea on the basis of a comparative analysis with the French Republic as the culturally and historically closest practice in the organization and financing of Guinean healthcare. Conduct a comparative analysis of the advantages and disadvantages characteristic of the healthcare systems of the Republic of Guinea and the French Republic, existing and potential threats. Develop and scientifically substantiate recommendations, setting tasks for future scientific research aimed at economic and mathematical modeling, financial analysis of the problems identified in this study, and suggest ways to eliminate the identified shortcomings. The conducted theoretical analysis represents an effective socio-economic toolkit and an information approach to the analysis of large-scale healthcare systems, aimed at finding and developing the most effective mechanisms for improving the healthcare system as one of the most important factors in the national security of the state. Almost all points of the comparative analysis carried out by the authors are recommended to be perceived as a statement of an actual problem, the solution of which is the subject of relevant subsequent research. The scientific article provides a comparative analysis of the healthcare systems of the Republic of Guinea and the French Republic. The common and distinctive features of both healthcare systems and the main directions of development of the Guinean healthcare system are noted. A significant lag between the healthcare system of the Republic of Guinea and the French Republic has been revealed, which may be one of the most important factors threatening the country's national security. It is concluded that the main directions for improving the healthcare system of the Republic of Guinea can be the following: medical savings accounts as a promising source of financing for Guinean healthcare; the preventive sector of protecting the health of citizens and the development of measures for the early prevention of socially significant diseases and epidemics as a factor in reducing the burden on the system of providing medical care to citizens; increasing the role and level of development of healthcare in the economic activity of the population and the investment climate of the country. The analysis of possible ways to improve the healthcare system of the Republic of Guinea presented in this article, based on the results of a comparative analysis with the French Republic, should become a very effective tool for the development of Russian healthcare using medical savings accounts as a promising system for its financing.
